name: Fields of Strife
description: A site in the Tor-Kathorra desert of a perpetual battle fought by restless spirits of the Blood Age.

description_citations.text: "Spirit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirol reports that the Fields of Strife are haunted by warriors re-enacting wars and that students must carry a mundane memento.
timeline.quote: The place is haunted by all kinds of old warriors who are stuck re-enacting old wars

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Kirol uses a war cry to dissolve a restless spirit that attacked while he carried a caryatid to Camp Herrian.
timeline.quote: I guess it was pretty good—they dissolved back into the currents.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani becomes Kirol's advisor for the Pranticle Peak expedition.
timeline.quote: Ajani's stepping in as my advisor!

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Kirol that trauma awakens a planeswalker's spark and that he lost his brother Jazal.
timeline.quote: I lost my brother, Jazal.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam consoles Lluwen and tells him of a frightening encounter with the same spirit, who threw a spear at her group.
timeline.quote: He hurled a spectral spear at me.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani slashes the spear and destroys the spirit with his axe, then tells his charge to be more careful.
timeline.quote: He slashed the spear in two, and in the same motion brought the flat of his axe down on the spirit's head.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: At the Fields of Strife base camp, Quint decides to commune with the dead of the Blood Age and steps through the protective wards.
timeline.quote: then turned and stepped intentionally through the protection wards.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint relives a dead general's last memories and is warned by Tullus about losing himself in the fields.
timeline.quote: "If you're not careful, we can lose you to the fields,"

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint steps over the forbidden boundary line into the territory of the deep shades.
timeline.quote: Deliberately, not looking back, Quint stepped over the line.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: A warlord's memory overwhelms Quint; he grasps the Blind Eternities to pull free of the ghost.
timeline.quote: Firmly grasping the Blind Eternities, he pulled himself forward, through the ghost and into the open space beyond.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint falls through a crust of stone into a sinkhole.
timeline.quote: sending him toppling down into the dark.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint discovers a cache of Blood Age artifacts in the hidden chamber and takes a ceramic knife as proof.
timeline.quote: And he'd simply … fallen into a major historical find. Again.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint tells Dean Tullus of the discovery, and she assigns the geomancer Mica to go with him.
timeline.quote: Take Mica with you.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint and Mica return to the cache and find objects moved and some missing.
timeline.quote: Someone had been here.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint discovers Stella Lee packing the artifacts to take through an Omenpath for sale on New Capenna.
timeline.quote: I've got a buyer for old Arcavios artifacts over on New Capenna

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint summons ghostly echoes against Stella, who fights them off with a whip and escapes through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Stella Lee, moving fast now, leapt into the Omenpath and was gone

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Mica uncovers fossil footprints matching the creature from Colony's End and a mosaic of a tentacled horror, showing the Coin Empire reached Arcavios.
timeline.quote: The Coin Empire had definitely reached Arcavios.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint follows the trail of the Fomori back to Arcavios and guides younger students at the Fields of Strife.
timeline.quote: He's been investigating the remnants of the Fomori, mysterious multiversal colonizers lost to time.

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The Fields of Strife are formed during the Blood Age of Arcavios.
timeline.quote: The Fields of Strife were formed during the Blood Age of Arcavios
